title: toponym-semantics: analysis code for a pre-specified global test of whether place names remember floods
description: Analysis code, frozen protocol (docs/protocol/preregistration_v2.md, tag prereg-v2-frozen), multilingual lexicon and manuscript sources for the study 'Do place names remember floods? A pre-specified global test against satellite-observed inundation'. Derived data (cell tables, name readings, predictions and run summaries) are archived in a separate record.
